is a group of islands close together in a large body of water.

take pictures of Earth's surface from space. Satellite images show what landforms look like from above.
can be many different colors in satellite images. Land with trees or plants will look green. Land covered in snow will look white. Bare land will look tan or brown.

can also appear in many different colors. Sometimes it looks dark blue or even black. When sand or mud is mixed in the water, it can look brown. Sunlight reflecting off the water can make it look silver.
can appear as white or light gray on satellite images. They may look wispy or fluffy like clouds do when viewed from the ground.

example.text: This image shows a group of islands close together in a large body of water. This is an archipelago.
